{"path":"/results/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/sio2_melting_1_trial_2/calculate_msd_and_melting_point.py","content":"import MDAnalysis as mda
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD
import numpy as np

# Load the trajectory
def calculate_msd_and_melting_point(dump_file):
    u = mda.Universe(dump_file, format='LAMMPSDUMP')
    
    # Calculate MSD
    msd = EinsteinMSD(u, select='all', msd_type='xyz', fft=True)
    msd.run()
    
    # Extract MSD values
    msd_values = msd.results.msd
    
    # Identify melting point (first sudden jump in MSD after 500 ps)
    # Assuming 1 ps = 1000 timesteps (since timestep = 0.001 ps)
    melting_point_frame = np.argmax(np.diff(msd_values[500:])) + 500
    
    # Calculate diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in molten state
    # Using MSD after the detected melting point
    diffusion_constant = np.mean(np.diff(msd_values[melting_point_frame:])) / (6 * 0.001)
    
    return diffusion_constant

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    dump_file = sys.argv[1]
    diffusion_constant = calculate_msd_and_melting_point(dump_file)
    print(f"Diffusion Constant: {diffusion_constant:.2e}")
